Move the uav to another location.desc: This action enables a uav to move from its current location to a new location. For example, the uav can move from the location_1 to location_2.
Move the uav to another location.abstract_desc: This action enables a uav to move from [position1] to [position2].

Pick up a blood sample from a location.desc: This action enables a uav to pick up a blood sample from some location if the uav is holding nothing. For example, the uav picks up a sample at the location_1.
Pick up a blood sample from a location.abstract_desc: This action enables a uav to load [object1] from [position1] if the uav is [state1].

Deliver a blood sample to a location.desc: This action enables a uav to deliver a carried blood sample to a target location. The uav must be holding the sample and be at the target location. For example, the uav drop the sample to the location_2.
Deliver a blood sample to a location.abstract_desc: This action enables a uav to unload [object1] to [position1] if the uav is [state1] and it is at [position1].
